experiment: Johansson et al., MSB450 (2012), §2.2 and Table B.2, shot 10, location 4
experiment_charge: Spherical 0.4 kg m/46, 86% PETN and 14% mineral oil, centre at 0.2 m above ground

provenance.source: Zakrisson, Wikman and Häggblad (2011), International Journal of Impact Engineering 38, Table 3, printed p. 602
provenance.evidence: Density, detonation velocity, PCJ and JWL table. E0 = 7.05 kJ/cm³ = 7.05 GJ/m³ of initial charge volume.

provenance.source: IMPETUS Afea official documentation, verification of explosives, Tables 1 and 2
provenance.evidence: The NSP-711 m/46 rows reproduce the density, detonation velocity, volumetric energy and the five JWL coefficients, citing Helte et al.

provenance.source: Helte, Lundgren, Örnhed and Norrefeldt (2006), FOI-R--2051--SE
provenance.evidence: Official abstract confirms calibration from cylinder expansion and detonation velocity. The full report was unavailable during review. Direct detonation-pressure measurements were unsuccessful according to the abstract.

model_limits: Instantaneous JWL products at t=0. The literature detonation velocity and PCJ document provenance; neither drives this initialization.
Keep the existing assumed product Cv of 1000 J/(kg K) and molar mass closure. The OpenFOAM phase label petn is retained as an internal identifier for m/46 products.
Source energy is total product energy per initial charge volume, with no added activation heat. The glass shell and initiation hardware are omitted.
Keep existing ideal-gas air, rigid walls, ground and geometry. Keep HLLC, first-order reconstruction, Euler and maxCo 0.15.
The AUTODYN data provide a separate numerical diagnostic for the paper's pure-PETN surrogate. Use the fixed 24 experimental values for the primary comparison.
